author: naren-ambati · merged by: naren-ambati
title: Make findSku case-insensitive
description:
Scanned codes arrive upper-case. Catalog skus are lower-case; compare lower-case, with tests.

--- src/catalog.js (modified, +1 −1)
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
 export const CATALOG = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("./catalog.json", import.meta.url), "utf8"));
-export const findSku = (sku) => CATALOG.find((i) => i.sku === sku) ?? null;
+export const findSku = (sku) => CATALOG.find((i) => i.sku === String(sku).toLowerCase()) ?? null;

--- test/catalog.test.js (added, +6 −0)
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+import { test } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { findSku } from "../src/catalog.js";
+
+test("findSku ignores case", () => assert.equal(findSku("SKU-0001").name, "Item 1"));
+test("an unknown sku is null", () => assert.equal(findSku("nope"), null));
